Sachin Pilot predicts Congress majority in Punjab polls

Sachin Pilot, expressing confidence in the Congress party's prospects, stated that the party will win the upcoming Punjab elections with an absolute majority. He cited a loss of public faith in the current Aam Aadmi Party government and a prevailing desire for change among the electorate. Pargat Singh, the newly appointed Punjab Congress president, called for collective action within the party.
